subject: general
question: An angle greater than 180 degrees is referred to as ________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __a reflex angle.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Reflex angle__ is an angle that is greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees.
 
• Such angles are larger than a straight angle (180°) and smaller than a full rotation (360°).
 
• Examples of reflex angles include angles measuring 200°, 270°, or 310°.
 
• Reflex angles can be found in various geometrical shapes and contexts such as circular measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Acute Angle:**

 
 
• An angle measuring less than 90 degrees.
 
• Examples include 30°, 45°, or 60°.
 
 
 
• **Obtuse Angle: **
 
 
• Angles greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.
 
• Examples include 120° or 150°.
 
 
 
• **Right Angle:**
 
 
• An angle that measures exactly 90 degrees.
 
• It is often represented by a small square at the corner of two lines.
